content:
For OpenSearch Service, you pay for each hour of use of an EC2 instance and for the cumulative
size of any EBS storage volumes attached to your instances. Standard AWS data transfer charges
also apply.
However, some notable data transfer exceptions exist. If a domain uses multiple Availability
Zones, OpenSearch Service does not bill for traﬃc between the Availability Zones. Signiﬁcant
data transfer occurs within a domain during shard allocation and rebalancing. OpenSearch Service
neither meters nor bills for this traﬃc. Similarly, OpenSearch Service does not bill for data transfer
between UltraWarm/cold nodes and Amazon S3.
For full pricing details, see Amazon OpenSearch Service pricing. For information about charges
incurred during conﬁguration changes, see the section called “Charges for conﬁguration changes”.
